verses.1: And Israel dwelt in the wilderness, and the people began to prostitute themselves with the daughters of Moab.
verses.2: And they called upon the people to worship their gods. Then the people ate and worshipped their gods.
verses.3: And Israel became a bondage to the king of Egypt. And Jehovah struck Israel severely.
verses.4: And the LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of the people and arrange them in front of the LORD, facing the sun. Then let the horn of the LORD be sounded from among the Israelites.”
verses.5: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Kill those who are attached to the owner of the oxen.”
verses.6: And behold, one of the sons of Israel came and brought the golden ring before Moses and before all the congregation of the sons of Israel. They wept at the entrance to the Tabernacle.
verses.7: And Pinchas, son of Elazar, son of Aaron, the priest, saw this. He stood up from among the people, and took a stick in his hand.
verses.8: And after that, one of the Israelites went to the place where they were trapped. He brought both man and woman back to their place. Then the plague was stopped among the Israelites.
verses.9: And there were four hundred and ten thousand dead in the plague.
verses.10: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.11: Pinhas son of Elazar, son of Aaron, the priest, has restored my jealousy over the children of Israel. He has shown his jealousy towards them, but he has not let go of the children of Israel due to his jealousy.
verses.12: Therefore, I say, I will give him my covenant of peace.
verses.13: And it shall be a covenant between him and his descendants forever, under the condition that they fear their God. And he shall enforce this covenant upon the children of Israel.
verses.14: And the name of the Israelite man who composed the song of Miriam, son of Salom, chief priest of the House of Av.
verses.15: And the name of the woman who was raised from the dead was Zebi, daughter of Zur. She lived in Midian, in the house of her father.
verses.16: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.17: Forgive those who have sinned against you, and do not hold them accountable for their actions.
verses.18: For they are like those who have been deceived by their own lies. They were deceived by things that were false and dishonest. It’s like the daughter of Midian, who was deceived by those who spread false rumors about her. She was deceived on the day of the plague.
verses.19: And after the plague passed away.
